 P.S. - Chiniya, District-Garhwa (Jharkhand)

... Appel  Versus  1 - State Of Chhattisgarh Through - Station House Officer Police Station -  Ramchandrapur Distt. - Balrampur - Ramanujganj (C.G.)
 ...
Responde For Appellant : Mr. A.N. Pandey, Advocate For Respondents : Ms. Sunita Manikpuri, Dy.
Government Advocate SB: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge ORDER ON BOARD 03/09/2025 1.

This Criminal Appeal is filed by the Appellant under Section 14 (A) (2) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 seeking bail in connection with Crime No.
03/2024, registered at Police Station - Ramchandrapur, District - Balrampur-Ramanujganj,
Chhattisgarh for the offences punishable under Sections 365, 376, 506, 493, 376 (D) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 3 (1) (b) (i) & 3 (2) (v) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that he do not want to press this appeal seeeking bail of the appellant.
Digitally SHUBHAM signed by DEY SHUBHAM  DEY 3.
In view of the submissions made by learned Counsel for the appellant, this appeal is dismisssed as withdrawn.
